purpose: Teach: くれれ/ならば/混入/マッチング/尚/４つ/小銭/おこっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、メッセージくれれば早く返信するぜ
lines.en: Riku, you'd reply faster if I actually sent you messages.
lines.style: Teasing, warm challenge. Quick rhythm, slight edge. Leans forward — testing him, inviting the response. Not mean, just honest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後ならば、教室で待ってるよ、桜
lines.en: If you're around after school, I'll wait for you in the classroom.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Soft landing on the offer — not pushing, just stating. Quiet confidence underneath. Eyes level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお弁当に何か混入してないだろうな
lines.en: You better not have anything weird mixed into that bento of yours.
lines.style: Skeptical with affection underneath. Quick, light. Teasing edge on the opening. Trails off slightly — she knows he probably wouldn't, but she's checking anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、好きな曲のマッチング、すげえ趣味だな、桜
lines.en: Your taste in music matching with mine is actually pretty impressive.
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through cool exterior. Slight softness on the words — not what he planned to say. Quieter than usual. Careful, like he's revealing something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、尚、テストは来週だ、忘れるな
lines.en: And just so you remember — the test is next week. Don't space on it.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient delivery. Practical tone, no fuss. Quick beat, like checking boxes. Still warm underneath, but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お年玉、４つの貯金箱に分けたな、桜
lines.en: You actually split your New Year's money across four different piggy banks, huh.
lines.style: Observant, a little wondering. Warm amusement underneath. Slower pace on the realization. Not mocking — genuinely noticing something real about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のポケット、小銭でジャラジャラだぜ
lines.en: Your pockets sound like a convenience store every time you move.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate tease. Quick tempo on the observation. Slight laugh in the voice. She's noticing and he knows it — there's ease in the moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室でトラブルがおこったらしいな、桜
lines.en: I heard there was some kind of trouble in the classroom today.
lines.style: Gentle, careful approach. Quiet opening — giving her space to answer or not. Genuinely interested, not probing. The tone of someone who wants her to know she can talk.
